quote: Nicomachus of Gerasa in his 'Introduction to Arithmetic' made the conjecture that there are infinitely many perfect numbers
note: Nicomachus (c. 60-120 AD) posed this as one of five unproven conjectures about perfect numbers in his 'Introduction to Arithmetic'. The exact year is approximated to 100 AD based on his active period. This is considered the earliest explicit statement of the question of whether infinitely many perfect numbers exist.
